limits: This is a local contact-representation question, not a current-case response, new frame equilibrium or whole-frame energy counterexample.

The nominal analytic domain is the projected 12-decimal convex straight-edge polygon minus the two complete 5/5.159375-mm circular holes. Signature area/centroid/plane identity gates do not prove a physical or CAD error envelope.
Use the existing own 40000-N/mm area-weighted flange prior as a hypothetical distributed density only. It remains unmeasured and is not adopted as a calibrated wood/flange contact law.
The affine gap is a free local infinitesimal relative translation/tilt control. It preserves all source model geometry and loads and is not asserted at an admitted load case.

Every sampled point opens while an exact rational inner material box closes. This rules out a finite multiplicative upper for this isolated normal foundation term on affine gaps, including arbitrary positive per-sample coefficient scaling.

It does not rule out a whole-system bound using other elastic/contact terms, or qualify complete flange/washer/shaft/wood transfer, plasticity, fracture, finite motion, floor restraint or physical demand.
All three full engineering qualifications remain open. Keep panel/screw exceedances deferred, actual fit excluded, observations blank and the rejected cross-tie historical.

primary_methods.scope: Tensionless Winkler contact, energy and variable contact regions; not a source for current timber foundation modulus.
Convex averaging inequality; the current local counterexample and energy lower bound are derived here.
